observations: Photo 0 shows a plastic-wrapped machine with 'SHARP' and 'AR-M207' printed on the front panel.
Photo 1 shows the same unit from an angle, confirming 'SHARP AR-M207' text and a 'digital' logo badge, plus visible paper size labels 'A4' and 'A3' on a stacked unit below.
Photo 2 is a close duplicate angle of photo 0, still wrapped in plastic, no controls, screen, or paper trays visible.
All three photos show the machine fully wrapped in cellophane/plastic, suggesting it has not been unpacked or powered on for the listing.
No power cable, display panel, toner, or output sample is visible in any photo.
Watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' overlaid on all photos, indicating a reseller/dealer listing.

claims.evidence: No documentation, import sticker, or usage log visible in any photo; claim cannot be checked remotely.

claims.claim: Packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not tied to any visible feature or test in the photos.

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal faults (common with 'London used' copiers sold as-is).
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the unit powered on, showing the control panel lit and a test print or copy output.

risks.risk: Toner/drum levels and print quality unknown; low or expired consumables are common in used copiers.
risks.proof: A clear photo of a fresh printed/copied page showing toner density and no streaks.

risks.risk: Scanner glass, ADF, and internal rollers condition cannot be assessed because the unit is fully wrapped in plastic.
risks.proof: Unwrapped photos of the scanner bed, ADF, and paper feed rollers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown condition, worst case with wear

risks.risk: Page/copy count (usage history) is unknown, which affects remaining service life.
risks.proof: A photo of the counter/meter screen on the control panel.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and completing a copy or print job.
Close-up photo of the control panel counter showing total page count.
Unwrapped photos of the scanner glass, ADF, and paper trays.
Photo of a freshly printed test page to assess toner/print quality.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly readable as Sharp AR-M207 from photo 0 and photo 1, so it can be priced, but since no power-on, print test, or unwrapped internal view is shown, it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-functional unit.
